---
title: "DERBi PIE Symbol Keyboard (Prototype)"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

<style>
  :root { --gap: 8px; --radius: 10px; --border: #bbb; }
  .wrap { max-width: 1050px; margin: 0 auto; }

  /* Search row */
  .search-row { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:stretch; margin: 8px 0 12px; }
  #search {
    flex: 1;
    font-size: 18px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
  }
  #kbToggle {
    width: 48px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 20px;
    user-select: none;
  }
  #kbToggle:hover { background: #f3f3f3; }

  /* Keyboard */
  #kbPanel {
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: #fafafa;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .base-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(13, minmax(44px, 1fr));
    gap: var(--gap);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .base-btn {
    padding: 10px 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .base-btn.active { background: #e9f0ff; border-color: #99b4ff; }
  .base-btn:hover { background: #f3f3f3; }

  .row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--gap); margin: 10px 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .label { width: 34px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; user-select: none; }

  .variant-strip {
    display: grid;
    grid-auto-flow: column;
    grid-auto-columns: minmax(44px, 1fr);
    gap: var(--gap);
    flex: 1;
  }
  .key-btn {
    padding: 10px 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 18px;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .key-btn:hover { background: #f3f3f3; }

  /* Modifiers */
  .mods { margin-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid #ddd; padding-top: 12px; }
  .mods-head {
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:12px;
    margin-bottom:8px;
  }
  .mods-row { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; }

  .mod {
    min-width: 56px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    font-size: 22px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .mod:hover { background: #f3f3f3; }
  .mod[disabled] { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .mod.active { background: #dff3e3; border-color: #7fc38a; }

  .subtle { opacity: .8; font-size: 13px; }
</style>

<div class="wrap">

  <!-- Search bar + keyboard toggle button (⌨) -->
  <div class="search-row">
  ```{=html}
    <input id="search" type="text"
           placeholder="Search… (click ⌨ for symbols)"
           autocomplete="off" />
    <button id="kbToggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" title="Show / hide symbol keyboard">⌨</button>
  ```
  </div>

  <!-- Keyboard panel (hidden by default) -->
  <div id="kbPanel" hidden>
  ```{=html}
    <div class="subtle" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
      Click symbols to insert. Then click modifiers to adjust the previous symbol (or a selection).
    </div>

    <!-- Base keys -->
    <div id="baseGrid" class="base-grid" aria-label="Base keys"></div>

    <!-- Variants row -->
    <div class="row" aria-label="Variants">
      <div id="activeLabel" class="label">–</div>
      <div id="variantStrip" class="variant-strip"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Modifiers -->
    <div class="mods" id="modifiers">
      <div class="mods-head">
        <strong>Modifiers</strong>
        <span class="subtle">Apply to previous symbol (or selection)</span>
      </div>

      <div class="mods-row">
        <button class="mod" data-mod="acute">X́</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="underdot">X̣</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="macron">X̄</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="syllabic">X̥</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="glide">X̯</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="aspiration" title="Aspiration">ʰ</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="labialization" title="Labialization">ʷ</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="sub1" title="Subscript 1">₁</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="sub2" title="Subscript 2">₂</button>
        <button class="mod" data-mod="sub3" title="Subscript 3">₃</button>
      </div>

      <div class="subtle" style="margin-top:8px;">
        Last modifier: <span id="lastModLabel">none</span> (double-click in the search box to reapply)
      </div>

      <!-- Language selector -->
      <div style="margin-top:14px; border-top:1px solid #ddd; padding-top:12px;">
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px;">
          <strong>Language</strong>
          <span class="subtle">Filters the keyboard symbols</span>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-top:8px; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <label for="langSelect" class="subtle" style="font-weight:600;">Mode:</label>
          <select id="langSelect"
                  style="padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid #bbb; border-radius:10px; background:#fff;">
            <option value="pie" selected>PIE (core)</option>
            <option value="sanskrit">Sanskrit (IAST)</option>
            <option value="avestan">Avestan (translit)</option>
            <option value="greek">Greek (romanized)</option>
            <option value="all">All (show everything)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  ```
  </div>
</div>

<script>
/* =========================
   DERBi PIE keyboard logic
   (no Alt shortcuts)
   ========================= */

/* 1) Symbol inventory (starter sets) */
const FAMILIES_BY_LANG = {
  pie: {
    A: ["a","ā"],
    B: ["b","bʰ"],
    D: ["d","dʰ"],
    E: ["e","ē"],
    G: ["g","gʰ","gʷ","gʷʰ","ǵ","ǵʰ"],
    H: ["h","h₁","h₂","h₃"],
    I: ["i","i̯"],
    K: ["k","kʷ","ḱ"],
    L: ["l","l̥"],
    M: ["m","m̥"],
    N: ["n","n̥"],
    O: ["o","ō"],
    R: ["r","r̥"],
    S: ["s","ś","ṣ"],
    T: ["t","ṭ"],
    U: ["u","u̯"]
  },

  sanskrit: {
    A: ["a","ā"],
    I: ["i","ī"],
    U: ["u","ū"],
    R: ["ṛ","ṝ"],
    L: ["l","ḷ"],
    E: ["e","ai"],
    O: ["o","au"],
    K: ["k","kh"],
    G: ["g","gh"],
    C: ["c","ch"],
    J: ["j","jh"],
    T: ["t","th","ṭ","ṭh"],
    D: ["d","dh","ḍ","ḍh"],
    N: ["n","ṇ","ṅ","ñ"],
    P: ["p","ph"],
    B: ["b","bh"],
    M: ["m"],
    Y: ["y"],
    R2: ["r"],
    L2: ["l"],
    V: ["v"],
    S: ["s","ś","ṣ"],
    H: ["h"]
  },

  avestan: {
    A: ["a","ā"],
    I: ["i","ī"],
    U: ["u","ū"],
    K: ["k","x"],
    G: ["g","γ"],
    T: ["t","ṱ","θ"],
    D: ["d","δ"],
    S: ["s","š"],
    Z: ["z","ž"],
    M: ["m"],
    N: ["n","ŋ"],
    R: ["r"],
    L: ["l"],
    H: ["h"]
  },

  greek: {
    A: ["a"],
    E: ["e"],
    I: ["i"],
    O: ["o"],
    U: ["u","y"],
    B: ["b"],
    G: ["g"],
    D: ["d"],
    K: ["k"],
    L: ["l"],
    M: ["m"],
    N: ["n"],
    P: ["p"],
    R: ["r"],
    S: ["s"],
    T: ["t"],
    H: ["h"]
  }
};

function mergeAllFamilies() {
  const merged = {};
  for (const lang of Object.keys(FAMILIES_BY_LANG)) {
    const fam = FAMILIES_BY_LANG[lang];
    for (const base of Object.keys(fam)) {
      const b = base.replace(/[0-9]+$/, "");
      merged[b] = merged[b] || [];
      for (const ch of fam[base]) if (!merged[b].includes(ch)) merged[b].push(ch);
    }
  }
  return merged;
}
FAMILIES_BY_LANG.all = mergeAllFamilies();

/* 2) Modifier composition maps */
const APPLY = {
  acute: { k: "ḱ", g: "ǵ", s: "ś" },
  underdot: { t: "ṭ", d: "ḍ", n: "ṇ", r: "ṛ", l: "ḷ", s: "ṣ" },
  macron: { a: "ā", e: "ē", i: "ī", o: "ō", u: "ū" },
  syllabic: { r: "r̥", l: "l̥", m: "m̥", n: "n̥" },
  glide: { i: "i̯", u: "u̯" },
  aspiration: { b: "bʰ", d: "dʰ", g: "gʰ", "gʷ": "gʷʰ", ǵ: "ǵʰ" },
  labialization: { k: "kʷ", g: "gʷ" },
  sub1: { h: "h₁" },
  sub2: { h: "h₂" },
  sub3: { h: "h₃" }
};

const COMBINING = {
  acute: "\u0301",
  underdot: "\u0323",
  macron: "\u0304",
  syllabic: "\u0325",
  glide: "\u032F"
};

const APPEND = {
  aspiration: "ʰ",
  labialization: "ʷ"
};

/* 3) DOM elements */
const searchEl = document.getElementById("search");
const kbToggle = document.getElementById("kbToggle");
const kbPanel  = document.getElementById("kbPanel");

const baseGrid = document.getElementById("baseGrid");
const activeLabel = document.getElementById("activeLabel");
const variantStrip = document.getElementById("variantStrip");
const lastModLabel = document.getElementById("lastModLabel");
const langSelect = document.getElementById("langSelect");

/* 4) Language state + families getter */
let currentLang = "pie";

function getFamilies() {
  const src = FAMILIES_BY_LANG[currentLang] || FAMILIES_BY_LANG.pie;
  const out = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(src)) {
    const base = key.replace(/[0-9]+$/, "");
    out[base] = out[base] || [];
    for (const ch of src[key]) if (!out[base].includes(ch)) out[base].push(ch);
  }
  return out;
}

/* ✅ FIX: activeBase must be based on getFamilies(), not FAMILIES */
let activeBase = Object.keys(getFamilies()).sort()[0];

let lastModKey = null;

/* 5) Toggle show/hide keyboard */
function setKeyboardOpen(open) {
  kbPanel.hidden = !open;
  kbToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
  if (open) searchEl.focus();
}
kbToggle.addEventListener("click", () => setKeyboardOpen(kbPanel.hidden));
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Escape" && !kbPanel.hidden) setKeyboardOpen(false);
});

/* 6) Insertion helper */
function insertAtCaret(input, text) {
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;
  input.value = input.value.slice(0, start) + text + input.value.slice(end);
  const newPos = start + text.length;
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
  input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  input.focus();
}

/* 7) Treat gʷ as one unit */
function getTargetSymbol(textLeft) {
  const m = textLeft.match(/(.)(ʷ)?$/u);
  return m ? m[0] : null;
}

/* 8) Apply modifier */
function applyModifierToInput(inputEl, key) {
  const start = inputEl.selectionStart ?? inputEl.value.length;
  const end = inputEl.selectionEnd ?? inputEl.value.length;
  const text = inputEl.value;

  let left = text.slice(0, start);
  let right = text.slice(end);
  let target = "";

  if (start !== end) {
    const sel = text.slice(start, end);
    const t = getTargetSymbol(sel);
    if (!t) return false;
    target = t;
    left = text.slice(0, start) + sel.slice(0, sel.length - target.length);
  } else {
    const t = getTargetSymbol(left);
    if (!t) return false;
    target = t;
    left = left.slice(0, left.length - target.length);
  }

  const map = APPLY[key] || {};
  const replacement = map[target] || map[target.normalize("NFD")[0]];

  if (replacement) {
    inputEl.value = left + replacement + right;
    const pos = left.length + replacement.length;
    inputEl.setSelectionRange(pos, pos);
    inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    inputEl.focus();
    return true;
  }

  if (COMBINING[key]) {
    inputEl.value = left + target + COMBINING[key] + right;
    const pos = (left + target + COMBINING[key]).length;
    inputEl.setSelectionRange(pos, pos);
    inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    inputEl.focus();
    return true;
  }

  if (APPEND[key]) {
    inputEl.value = left + target + APPEND[key] + right;
    const pos = (left + target + APPEND[key]).length;
    inputEl.setSelectionRange(pos, pos);
    inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    inputEl.focus();
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

/* 9) Context-aware enabling */
function updateModifierAvailability(inputEl) {
  const text = inputEl.value;
  const start = inputEl.selectionStart ?? text.length;
  const end = inputEl.selectionEnd ?? text.length;

  let symbol = null;
  if (start !== end) symbol = getTargetSymbol(text.slice(start, end));
  else symbol = getTargetSymbol(text.slice(0, start));

  const base = symbol ? symbol.normalize("NFD")[0] : null;

  document.querySelectorAll(".mod").forEach(btn => {
    const key = btn.dataset.mod;
    btn.disabled = false;

    if (!symbol) { btn.disabled = true; return; }

    if (key.startsWith("sub")) { btn.disabled = (base !== "h"); return; }
    if (key === "macron") { btn.disabled = !(/[aeiou]/.test(base)); return; }
    if (key === "syllabic") { btn.disabled = !(/[rlmn]/.test(base)); return; }
    if (key === "glide") { btn.disabled = !(/[iu]/.test(base)); return; }
    if (key === "labialization") { btn.disabled = !(/[kg]/.test(base)); return; }
    if (key === "aspiration") { btn.disabled = !(/[bdgkpt]/.test(base) || symbol === "gʷ" || base === "ǵ"); return; }
    if (key === "acute") { btn.disabled = !(/[kgs]/.test(base)); return; }
    if (key === "underdot") { btn.disabled = !(/[tdnrls]/.test(base)); return; }
  });
}

/* 10) Render keyboard */
function renderBaseGrid() {
  const families = getFamilies();
  const bases = Object.keys(families).sort();
  baseGrid.innerHTML = "";
  bases.forEach(base => {
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.className = "base-btn" + (base === activeBase ? " active" : "");
    btn.textContent = base;
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      activeBase = base;
      renderBaseGrid();
      renderVariants();
      searchEl.focus();
    });
    baseGrid.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

function renderVariants() {
  const families = getFamilies();
  const variants = families[activeBase] || [];
  activeLabel.textContent = activeBase;
  variantStrip.innerHTML = "";
  variants.forEach(ch => {
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.className = "key-btn";
    btn.textContent = ch;
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      insertAtCaret(searchEl, ch);
      updateModifierAvailability(searchEl);
    });
    variantStrip.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

/* 11) Modifiers wiring */
function setLastMod(key) {
  lastModKey = key;
  lastModLabel.textContent = key || "none";
  document.querySelectorAll(".mod").forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.dataset.mod === key);
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll(".mod").forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (btn.disabled) return;
    const key = btn.dataset.mod;
    const ok = applyModifierToInput(searchEl, key);
    if (ok) {
      setLastMod(key);
      updateModifierAvailability(searchEl);
    }
  });
});

["input","click","keyup"].forEach(ev =>
  searchEl.addEventListener(ev, () => updateModifierAvailability(searchEl))
);

searchEl.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
  if (!lastModKey) return;
  const btn = document.querySelector(`.mod[data-mod="${lastModKey}"]`);
  if (btn && btn.disabled) return;
  applyModifierToInput(searchEl, lastModKey);
  updateModifierAvailability(searchEl);
});

/* 12) Language dropdown wiring */
langSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
  currentLang = langSelect.value;

  const families = getFamilies();
  if (!families[activeBase]) activeBase = Object.keys(families).sort()[0];

  renderBaseGrid();
  renderVariants();
  updateModifierAvailability(searchEl);
  searchEl.focus();
});

/* Init */
renderBaseGrid();
renderVariants();
updateModifierAvailability(searchEl);
</script>
